title: Help before the turn
body: The route sketch marks one aid bundle delivered before the families are listed. A child’s drawing of the return road is tucked behind the empty passenger line.
rival_reading: A field crew could have distributed the same bundle and kept a route sketch; the missing passenger names do not explain what brought them there.
gloss: An aid delivery is recorded before its passenger list is complete.

cites.quote: If you can make it before you turn. There's something here
